{{Youmay|an occupation|the short story by [[James Luceno]] named ''[[Darth Maul: Saboteur]]''}}
[[File:Sabotage-TCG_EoD_by_Owen_William_Weber.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] sabotaging a control center]]
{{Quote|We have stolen a small Imperial shuttle. Disguised as a cargo ship, and using a secret Imperial code, a strike team will land on the moon and deactivate the shield generator.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Madine]] at a briefing prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]|audio=Madine-Imperialshuttlestolen.flac|<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
A '''saboteur''' was an individual tasked with disrupting the normal operation of a physical mechanism. Both [[Species/Legends|organic]] beings and [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were capable of performing acts of sabotage. They were skilled at subtle manipulations designed for simple operation failure or the complete destruction of a target. Saboteurs were highly skilled and often combined the talents of a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]], [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] and explosives expert with the skills of a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] or [[Commando/Legends|commando]]. Saboteurs were used by governments, military, corporations, and criminal elements alike.

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|I don't ''have'' to blow up everything I see. I just like to.|Kell Tainer|<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Sabotage.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A Jedi sabotaging battle droid production during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].]]

Saboteurs operated covertly using stealth, often infiltrating a location by posing as an individual authorized to be there. They could work individually if infiltrating a single structure or in small teams when their target was an entire complex or covering a larger area.<ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Well trained saboteurs could damage anything from weapons and vehicles to [[Computer/Legends|computer]] systems, and the best of them could subtly manipulate machinery to appear in perfect working order until the designated moment when they would malfunction catastrophically, typically at the moment it will wreak the most havoc.<ref name="TotG">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref> The objectives of a saboteur ranged from simply disabling a particular machine, such as a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] or power grid, or the complete destruction of a building, complex or base.<ref name="TFUCG" />

Most saboteurs were skilled in multiple fields of expertise due to the various forms and degrees of sabotage they were tasked with. They often had to be able to slice into computer systems and know their way around an [[Engine/Legends|engine]], as well as be an explosives expert and proficient with many kinds of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons]]. They were also required to be convincing performers as they were frequently required to play a role to infiltrate a particular target location.<ref name="TotG" />

==History==
{{Quote|Pretty. What do we blow up first?|[[Wraith Squadron]] motto, first coined by [[Myn Donos]]|<ref name="X-Wing: Solo Command">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] deployed [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|buzz droids]], a type of insect-like [[Droid/Legends|automaton]], in swarms during [[Space warfare/Legends|battlefleet actions]] to wreak havoc upon [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] that happened to fly through a formation of such deployed droids. Buzz droids were equipped with drill heads, plasma cutting torches, [[Circular saw/Legends|circular saws]], prying hooks and pincer arms for disabling their targets.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

[[File:Sabotage_Operation.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Two [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]] during a sabotage operation]]

Before the formation of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], ex-[[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] sabotaged [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE series/Legends|TIE fighter]] production when he and his militia troops took over a [[TIE Fighter Construction Facility]] over [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. He and his forces were [[Battle of the TIE Fighter Construction Facility|defeated]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Galen Marek|secret apprentice]].<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

Before becoming a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], [[Kyle Katarn]] worked as an agent of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], often committing acts of sabotage against Imperial targets. While tracking down the origins of the [[Dark Trooper Project]], Katarn infiltrated and destroyed a [[Gromas Mines|mining facility]] on [[Gromas 16]], halting the Empire's flow of [[phrikite]]. He later infiltrated and caused the destruction of the ''[[Arc Hammer]]'', the factory ship where [[Dark Trooper/Legends|Dark troopers]] were produced.<ref name="DF">''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''</ref>

Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Anya Karu]]'' was destroyed by Rebel Alliance saboteurs. Rather than admit to a defeat by a handful of Rebels, the Empire blamed [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Aron Harcourt]] for the ship's destruction and demoted him to desk job on Coruscant. The Empire dispatched the [[Liberator (Imperial I-class)|''Adjudicator'']] to destroy the wreckage of the ''Anya Karu'' to eliminate any evidence of the Rebels' involvement in its downfall.<ref name="Wreckage">[[Empire 28|''Empire'' 28]]</ref>

The [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] made use of elite commandos, known as [[Defiler]]s, that were completely loyal to their leader, [[Tyber Zann]]. Defilers were trained to both protect and advance the Consortium's influence and power. They were skilled [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], enforcers, and saboteurs. They resorted to kidnapping, manipulations, bribery, threats, virtually any means necessary to spread the corruption of the Zann Consortium.<ref name="EAWFOC">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>

[[File:Saboteur-TFUCG.png|thumb|left|150px|A [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] saboteur.]]

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] led a [[Endor strike team/Legends|strike team]] to the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]] to destroy the [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator]] protecting the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]]. After initially being captured by Imperial forces, the strike team was able to plant explosives causing the destruction of the generator. Once the shield was deactivated, Rebel Alliance fighters, led by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], were able to penetrate the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] superstructure and destroy the battle station, ending the dictatorial reign of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

After infiltrating [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] was able to [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|hijack]] a [[Construction droid/Legends|Construction droid]] to take them to the command building. There, they took remote control of one of the orbiting [[Orbital Solar Energy Transfer Satellite|solar mirrors]]. focusing a light beam from the mirror directly onto one of the planet's reservoirs. The flash-boiled water caused a massive electrical storm, overloading the shield station power supply, causing the shields to collapse allowing the New Republic to liberate the planet.<ref name="XWWG">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>

[[Wraith Squadron]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadron, used deception and sabotage on numerous occasions during the [[Hunt for Zsinj|campaign]] to draw [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] into the open. Posing as gang of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], they disrupted the warlord's supply line. Rather than destroy the "pirate gang", Zsinj hired them to work for him, allowing the Wraiths closer contact than ever before. Their continued ploy resulted in the destruction of the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Razor's Kiss]]'', preventing it from falling into Zsinj's hands.<ref name="XWIF">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref>

[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar's]] personal [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]], [[Terpfen]] was an unwitting sleeper agent for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Furgan]] of [[Carida/Legends|Carida]]. He sabotaged Ackbar's personal [[B-wing/E starfighter|B-wing/E2]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] which caused it to crash into the [[Cathedral of Winds/Legends|Cathedral of Winds]] on [[Vortex/Legends|Vortex]]. This accident destroyed the cathedral, killing hundreds of native [[Vor]]s and nearly killing Ackbar and his passenger, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]].<ref name="DA">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref>

After being imprisoned on [[Coruscant/Legends#Yuuzhan'tar|Yuuzhan'tar]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Jacen Solo befriended the [[World Brain]]. After escaping with [[Vergere]], he revealed that he had left instructions for the World Brain to sabotage<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the ongoing [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] in tiny and annoying ways. The Brain made small things go wrong in the process and teach the Yuuzhan Vong to compromise with other species.<ref name="Traitor">''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]''</ref>
